skills.detail: Reduces damage received from enemies while the skill button is held down. Deals a long-range area attack after a certain period of time or when the skill button is released. Adds the amount of reduced damage received from enemies while the skill is active to the damage dealt to enemies. However, any damage reduced by Trait effects will not be added. Nullifies Stagger for a set period of time.
